remarks: Ideally positioned on the 14th floor, this sophisticated one bedroom redefines luxury living with a grand entry, wood floors, marble counters, modern stainless steel appliances, gracious primary suite, and panoramic views of Mill River Park. Additional features include a slate-floor balcony and ample closet space. The ultimate in convenience, Park Tower provides an impressive amenity package, including; saltwater pool, fitness center, resident retreat, 24-hour concierge, doorman, and shuttle. Trendy restaurants, theatres, shops and more located just beyond the front door.
